goal: Bounded measurement of whether a LONG outer-B.Cu zero-via corridor (1.50 target / 1.20 floor) can close the BAT_PROTECTED_P trunk from R75.2 to the eastern node copper, now that the short western-margin corridor is proven severed (D-272).

central_free_channel_mm.note: single connected free region linking west margin to node west edge

budgets.note: Budgets are set inside the probe (QR.ASTAR_BUDGET / QR.WAVE_BUDGET). A timeout is recorded as reason=TIMEOUT, a legitimate bounded failure. A coarse-blocked hop is recorded as reason=COARSE_BLOCKED without ever running the fine search.

mid exit latitude; joins the node west tip (closest node copper, 5.5 mm)
lowest exit latitude; joins node SE diagonal

families.src: D9 reservation free end (10.800,73.000) as trunk FIRST segment
families.escape_latitude: exit south from the reserved end
families.distinct_because: tests whether D9's own committed exit reaches the node the long way, continuous B.Cu

coverage_argument: Every long B.Cu corridor from the western margin to the node must (1) escape the western control-copper mass and (2) cross the single central free channel to the node west tip. The channel is one connected free region, so it is not the discriminator; the ESCAPE LATITUDE is. The western mass is thinnest at exactly three latitudes (north/mid/south), covered by F1/F2/F3; F4 covers the reservation's own exit. No fourth macroscopically distinct family exists (east is the node, west is the board edge). Additional sampled anchors would only re-probe the same channel -- the un-bounded trap this replaces.
parent_commands: python3 long_corridor_003a_bounded.py   # default: proven parent board -> place_002z/long_corridor_003a_bounded.json
expected_runtime: seconds to ~1 min (bounded); contrast the interrupted un-bounded sweep at >18 min for a single trial (rc130).
read_only_helpers: place_002z/inspect_003a.py  -- board edges, pads, BPP copper clusters, reservation stub (no routing)
place_002z/occ_003a.py      -- ASCII B.Cu occupancy map of the working band (one grid build, no wave)
place_002z/joins_003a.py    -- exact nearest node-copper join point per channel exit

corroboration.why: A 0.25 mm COARSE prefilter can OVER-block, so a COARSE_BLOCKED verdict alone is not proof no 1.20 mm corridor exists. This runs the SAME QR.connect_role the router uses for the trunk, R75.2 -> node copper, at the DEFAULT FULL budgets (ASTAR=500000, WAVE=3000) with NO coarse prefilter, per-trial wall-clock capped.
corroboration.result: ALL 8 trials FAIL: @1.50 NO_LEGAL_ESCAPE to every node target (R75.2 cannot leave its pad at 1.5 mm), @1.20 NO_PATH to every node target after a full-budget reachable-region exhaustion (~48-62 s, not a timeout). Confirms the bounded probe's COARSE_BLOCKED verdict is real, not an artifact.

regression: router_regression.py G11 pins the D-273 bounded-search contract on the AUTHORITATIVE board: a tiny budget BOUNDS the search (prompt NO_PATH, no copper, no raise) and the probe budget (ASTAR=60000/WAVE=1200) does NOT fabricate a FAIL (still routes a routable short trunk). 4/4 PASS.

validation_run_result.note: Re-run end-to-end and reproduced byte-identically (routing verdicts; only the board-path string and wall-clock dt differ). Corroborated by the full-budget real search above.
validation_run_result.families: ALL FAIL both widths -- at 1.50 R75.2 has NO_LEGAL_ESCAPE on B.Cu; at 1.20 R75.2 escapes locally (~2.7 mm to 5.5,67.95) but the first traversal out of the western mass is COARSE_BLOCKED; F4 COARSE_BLOCKED both widths.
validation_run_result.verdict: No long outer-B.Cu 1.20/1.50 zero-via corridor exists. This is a measured FAIL, not analytic. Corroborates D-270/271/272 (western blocker is real current-carrying copper). The next technical task is a bounded named-path F.Cu high-current via-bridge investigation (evidence-based via-array sizing + full safety/DRC/connectivity gates); it is NOT implemented or tested in 003A.
